title: tantrasara-a01 — tsa-a01-v01
question: Mother — stainless art's abode, great new creation, full-bodied; Father — his five faces' splendor hidden: may the Heart, born of the surging nature of their embrace, the deathless kin beyond the highest, flash forth for me.
